Young Enterprise Scheme

Our Story

We’re a team of four passionate 15 and 16-year-old student founders from Long Bay College in Auckland running Biltong Bites as part of the Young Enterprise Scheme (YES).

Unlike mass-produced jerky, we handcraft our biltong using carefully selected, low-stress meat. This thoughtful curing method yields pieces that are naturally more tender, less acidic, and richer in wholesome flavor.

Driven by teamwork, passion, and high standards, we take pride in delivering a clean, high-protein snack made right here by the next generation of Kiwi entrepreneurs.
